create_qdrant_semantic_cache: create a QdrantSemanticCache instance with a collection name, similarity threshold, and Qdrant API base URL
set_cache_prompt: set a cache entry in Qdrant by embedding a prompt from messages and storing the response with its vector
get_cache_prompt: get a cached response from Qdrant by embedding a prompt and retrieving the closest matching cached result
async_set_cache_prompt: asynchronously set a cache entry in Qdrant using an async embedding call and batch point insertion
async_get_cache_prompt: asynchronously retrieve a cached response from Qdrant with semantic similarity score in metadata
